module: Node "Load Data" (category once_instant, color file). Loads simple data from a file, reusable between sessions. Input: file (name without extension). The custom output pins (types string, number, bool, any, table, vec3, quat, color) carry the names of the keys read; each output receives the value of the key with the same name via modules.file:read.
notes: The description of the file pin says "save into" but here it is the file to read.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Enables pin saving and custom output pins.

workOnce.desc: For each output pin (except flow), reads the corresponding value from the file.
